observations.what: The function _generic_abstract_tokens is defined but incomplete; it ends mid-line after calling _strip_comments_generic.
The _GEN_TOKEN regex matches single operator/punctuation characters but may miss multi-character operators like '==', '!=', etc.
The _strip_comments_generic function is called but not defined in this chunk; it must be defined elsewhere.
The fingerprint function uses hashlib.sha1 and returns only first 12 hex characters; this is a common but not collision-safe practice.
